messages.content:
You are a music metadata expert. A file was imported with incorrect or incomplete tags.

Filename: 03 - Some Song.flac
Current (possibly wrong) tags:
  title: Some Song
  artist: Some Artist
  album: Some Album
  albumartist: Some Artist
  year: 2012
  genre: (empty)
  track: 3
  label: (empty)
  mb_trackid: (empty)
  mb_albumid: (empty)
  mb_releasegroupid: (empty)
  filename: 03 - Some Song.flac
  source_path: /music/a/03 - Some Song.flac
  duration_seconds: 200.0
  duration: 3:20

MusicBrainz/AcoustID candidates (idx / match / score / title / artist / album / year / country / mb_trackid / source):
  [0] match=0.95 mb= 95 Some Song — Some Artist / Some Album (2012) US [11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111] via mb

RULES — apply strictly:
1. If AcoustID fingerprint candidates are available, prefer them over text-only matches and only use MB recordings from that candidate list.
   Do not silently override strong contradictory fingerprint evidence; return low confidence and explain the conflict.
2. If no AcoustID candidates are found, fall back to MusicBrainz text search results.
   If choosing a MusicBrainz candidate, copy its mb_trackid exactly; do not invent a recording ID.
3. FILENAME is the next most reliable clue. Filenames often follow 'Artist - Title' or 'NN - Artist - Title' patterns — extract the correct title and artist from it.
4. YEAR: output only a 4-digit year (e.g. 2012, not 20120923 or 2012-09-23).
5. ARTIST: use the correct performing artist, not a radio station, label, or 'Various Artists'.
6. ALBUM: if the file belongs to a known album, fill it in. Otherwise leave empty.
7. RELEASE PREFERENCE: prefer US releases (country=US). If no equally strong US match exists, use Worldwide (country=XW) before other countries.
8. FORMAT: prefer CD or Digital Media recordings. Avoid vinyl if a digital version exists.
9. CONFIDENCE — set one of:
   high:   certain of artist, title, year, and album
   medium: reasonably sure but one field is uncertain
   low:    guessing based on limited info

Return ONLY a valid JSON object with these keys (include only what you are confident about):
  title — clean track title only (no artist prefix)
  artist — performing artist using feat. notation: e.g. 'Young Money feat. Lil Wayne & Curren$y'
  album, albumartist, year (4-digit integer), genre, track (integer), tracktotal (integer),
  disc (integer), disctotal (integer), label,
  mb_trackid (recording UUID), mb_albumid (release UUID), mb_artistid (artist UUID),
  confidence (high|medium|low), reason (one sentence)

Example: {"title":"Poppin' Them Bottles","artist":"Young Money feat. Lil Wayne, Curren$y & Mack Maine","album":"Dedication 2","albumartist":"Lil Wayne","year":2006,"genre":"Hip-Hop","track":4,"mb_trackid":"b5316c12-b617-4086-a107-312eccfd12e7","confidence":"high","reason":"AcoustID fingerprint matches Lil Wayne Dedication 2 mixtape"}
